title: Local coefficients for genuine equivariant cohomology I
summary: We develop a theory of equivariant local systems which categorifies genuine equivariant cohomology theories -- such as Atiyah--Segal $K$-theory, Lurie's tempered cohomology, and the equivariant elliptic cohomology of Grojnowski, Greenlees, and Gepner--Meier -- analogously to how the category of ordinary local systems categorifies singular cohomology.
